sentences.en: His opinion does not arouse any echo in his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的意见并没有引起同事们的共鸣。

sentences.en: The colleague whose husband is French has left for Paris.
sentences.zh: 那位丈夫是法国人的同事已经去了巴黎。

sentences.en: My colleague filled in for me while I was sick.
sentences.zh: 我生病期间，我的同事替我值班。

senses.zh: 同事, 同行, 同僚
